model_visible_prompt:
Return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys; numbers must be JSON numbers, null where requested; no prose or Markdown. Numeric tolerance is 0.000001.
Synthetic simultaneous excerpts: SYNOP section 1: 11008 21012 49987; METAR: 00000KT 0200 FG VV/// M01/M01 Q0998. Assume SYNOP MSL pressure lies in 900–1099.9 hPa and is the underlying value from which METAR QNH is rounded down to an integer hPa. Return synop_temperature_c, synop_dewpoint_c, synop_msl_pressure_hpa, metar_qnh_hpa, pressure_consistent (integer 1 if floor(SYNOP pressure) equals QNH, otherwise 0), metar_ceiling_ft_agl (null if unknown).
